description: This file contains pytest test cases for testing FastAPI endpoints related to handling items with multiple parameters, including tests for request validation, response correctness, and API schema.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module based on request parameter and returns a TestClient instance for testing the FastAPI app.

methods.name: test_post_all(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests updating an item with all parameters provided, expecting a successful response with the correct item data.

methods.name: test_post_required(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests updating an item with only required parameters, expecting default None for optional fields.

methods.name: test_post_no_body(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the API's response when the request body is missing, expecting a validation error.

methods.name: test_post_like_not_embeded(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the API's response when the request body does not include the expected nested 'item' field, expecting a validation error.

methods.name: test_post_missing_required_field_in_item(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests the response when required fields in the 'item' are missing, expecting validation errors.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Fetches the OpenAPI schema and verifies it contains expected definitions for schema components and API paths.
